# FAIR research software assessment

Status: **provisional, advisory; not certified or scientifically qualified**.

The SHA-pinned howfairis GitHub Action evaluates public repository, standard licence, registry listing, citation metadata, and quality-checklist signals. It is a measurement, not an evidence audit or a release gate.

Before claiming compliance, document the actual hosted run and evaluated commit; verify source/data licensing and upstream rights, authorship and `CITATION.cff`, registry and DOI status, and reproducibility with exact fixtures. Record individual [ARDC FAIR checklist](https://github.com/ardc-fair-checklist/ardc-fair-checklist.github.io) answers with verifiable evidence rather than inferring them from howfairis.

Keep existing scientific, privacy, security, source-provenance, Conductor and release qualification intact. Reference [the optional standard](https://github.com/edithatogo/repository-standards/blob/main/docs/fair-research-software-standard.md). Reuse existing workflows; do not install a duplicate agent framework.
